quotes.name: Dax Monroe
quotes.quote: I've been thinking a lot about the cycles of life in Rockridge lately. The other night, I was at the window, just observing the world go by. It made me reflect on how people's lives are intertwined with the events around them. I've seen it in my own life, with my kids growing up and the community changing. It's like the lives of those 11 people must have been shaped by the events they experienced, just like mine are shaped by the everyday moments here in Rockridge.
